blocks.text: Condo buildings in Vancouver Heights

TOP FLAG — THE NAME LIES, AND THE MAP HAS THREE TRAPS. Vancouver Heights is in the City of Burnaby (North Burnaby, on and below the Capitol Hill rise, with Hastings Street as its spine) — not the City of Vancouver, despite the name. 4 apartment-condo buildings are known by name from building-directory plus listing evidence. Checked and out-of-area: Burnaby Hospital is at 3935 Kincaid St, south across the city — not in-area.
The Sienna — 3939 Hastings Street

A 22-home strata building: a building directory lists it as built in 1998, with bylaws of "pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions" and air conditioning, a garden and private yards. Rental restrictions have been void since November 24, 2022. Current listings call it "The Sienna", an apartment condo building in Vancouver Heights built in 1998, which matches the directory.
Heritage Green — 3978 Albert Street

A building directory lists Heritage Green as built in 1994 with 28 homes, in-suite laundry, and bylaws of "pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions". Rental restrictions have been void since November 24, 2022. A home at 3978 Albert Street is listed in Vancouver Heights on MLS®.
Evergreen Place — 3861 Albert Street

A building directory lists Evergreen Place as built in 1989, with in-suite laundry and bylaws of "pets allowed w/rest., rentals allowed w/restrictions". Rental restrictions have been void since November 24, 2022. The directory shows listings and sales at this address, most recently in October 2025; nothing was for sale when I checked.
Streets, schools and transit near Vancouver Heights condos

items.t: Vancouver Heights is a North Burnaby neighbourhood on and below the Capitol Hill rise, with Hastings Street as its main street; it's also the real estate board's name for the area. It runs roughly from Boundary Road west to Gamma Avenue east, and from Hastings Street north to Burrard Inlet. West of Boundary Road is the City of Vancouver (Hastings-Sunrise), a different city and area.

Where the condos are: low-rise strata buildings on Hastings Street and one block north on Albert Street. The rest of the area is mostly detached houses on a sloping hillside with views: early-to-mid-1900s homes, post-war bungalows and Vancouver Specials alongside newer rebuilds.

Transit: the R5 Hastings St RapidBus runs along Hastings Street through the Heights, linking Burrard Station in downtown Vancouver with SFU's Burnaby Mountain campus, at least every 10 minutes at peak and 15 minutes off-peak, with in-area stops including Hythe, Holdom and Kensington. On September 7, 2026, TransLink extended the R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus from Phibbs Exchange to Metrotown Station via Hastings Street and Willingdon Avenue, serving the Heights with peak service every 6–7 minutes and replacing the peak-only 222 bus. There is no SkyTrain station in this sub-area.

Schools (SD41 Burnaby): two elementary schools are on Pandora Street in the area, Confederation Park Elementary (4715 Pandora Street) and Rosser Elementary (4375 Pandora Street), and the catchment splits the street by address: 4375 Pandora is in Rosser Elementary and Alpha Secondary, and 4715 Pandora is in Confederation Park Elementary and Alpha Secondary. Check the catchment for a specific address with the school district.

Parks, recreation and civic: Confederation Park (250 Willingdon Ave), Eileen Dailly Leisure Pool & Fitness Centre (240 Willingdon Ave) and the McGill Branch of Burnaby Public Library (4595 Albert St) form the west-end civic cluster; Capitol Hill Reservoir Park (229 N Hythe Ave) is listed by the City as a scenic viewpoint park. The City's planned new Confederation Park Community Centre beside the pool and library has been deferred by the City. In August 2026 the Province announced funding for 20 new child-care spaces at Confederation Park Elementary.
Health care: there is no hospital in the sub-area; Burnaby Hospital is at 3935 Kincaid St, south across the city — checked, and out-of-area.

blocks.text: Good to know about Vancouver Heights condos

items.t: The building called "The Heights" isn't listed in Vancouver Heights. The Heights (3768 Hastings St, 1998, 37 homes) has this neighbourhood's name, but its MLS® listing puts it in Willingdon Heights. It's on the south side of Hastings at the west edge.
Carleton appears twice, too. Confirm the street address, not just the name, before booking a showing.

One street, two elementary schools, and the "obvious" secondary is not the right one. Pandora Street carries both in-area elementaries, and the SD41 locator splits it by address range: 4375 Pandora St → Rosser Elementary, 4715 Pandora St → Confederation Park Elementary, both feeding Alpha Secondary in the district's results, not Burnaby North Secondary, the school physically located in North Burnaby. Check the school by address rather than by name.
Detached houses sold quickly while condos and townhomes barely sold. Price a condo or townhome against other condo and townhome sales, not the detached numbers.

Burnaby replaced both of its governing documents within seven months. The Burnaby 2050 OCP (adopted December 9, 2025) replaced the 1998 OCP, and the Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026 (No. 14815, in effect July 1, 2026) replaced the 1965 zoning bylaw — and the new OCP takes precedence over the older neighbourhood community-plan maps, including for the Hastings corridor's Heights Urban Village. Any Heights document or old listing citing the 1965 bylaw or the 1998 OCP as current is out of date twice over.
The seniors tower stands on a heritage estate. The tower itself opened in 1974 and is rental/care: it anchors the area's seniors services without adding a single buyable unit.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Vancouver Heights
Streets, schools and transit near Vancouver Heights townhomes

items.t: Vancouver Heights is a City of Burnaby neighbourhood in northwest Burnaby (North Burnaby), on and below the Capitol Hill rise, with Hastings Street as its spine; the MLS® sub-area name (GVR board) is "Vancouver Heights." Nearby areas: Capitol Hill (the hilltop portion within/adjacent to this sub-area), Willingdon Heights, Parkcrest, Lochdale, Westridge, Burnaby Heights to the west, and the City of Vancouver (Hastings-Sunrise) across Boundary Road.
Where the townhouses are: there are no townhouse complexes here.

Schools (SD41 Burnaby): Rosser Elementary (K–7), 4375 Pandora Street, and Confederation Park Elementary (K–7), 4715 Pandora Street, both in the area, with Alpha Secondary (8–12) as the secondary. The two elementaries split Pandora Street by address (4303–4375 Pandora is in Rosser's catchment), while both are in Alpha's. Burnaby North Secondary (751 Hammarskjold Drive) is the other North Burnaby secondary, but being nearby doesn't put you in its catchment. Check the catchment for a specific address with the school district.

Transit: the R5 Hastings St RapidBus runs along Hastings through the Heights (Burrard Station to SFU; at least every 10 minutes at peak, 15 minutes off-peak; stops include Hythe, Holdom and Kensington). On September 7, 2026, TransLink extended the R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus from Phibbs Exchange to Metrotown Station via Hastings Street and Willingdon Avenue, serving Burnaby Heights with peak service every six to seven minutes and replacing the peak-only 222 bus.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Vancouver Heights

items.t: For any strata purchase, read the Form B: it shows the monthly fee, amounts owing, approved special levies, the contingency reserve balance and an insurance summary, with the rules, budget, any rental disclosure and the latest depreciation report. The strata must provide it within 7 days for at most $35 plus 25¢ a page.

SSMUH on house lots: under the R1 SSMUH District, most Heights lots allow 3–6 homes (6 only within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop) and multi-unit product may be stratified — so two otherwise similar houses can be worth very different amounts to builders depending on lot area and the 400 m transit test (the R5/R2 Hastings corridor makes that test live on many lots). Review the Burnaby 2050 OCP land use map and the Heights Urban Village direction before assuming redevelopment or assembly value on Hastings-fronting and near-Hastings properties, because the new OCP takes precedence over older community plan maps.

items.t: Zero townhome complexes is a finding, not a missing search. The Heights' ground-oriented supply is the detached house — which is exactly why its R1 multiplex potential, not a townhouse complex, is the ground-oriented conversation here.

blocks.text: Vancouver Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

15 condos sold in Vancouver Heights with a median price of $565,000 (the middle half sold between $491,500 and $976,900), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 95.9% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $790 per square foot, a median year built of 2006 and a median strata fee of $397 a month. 5 townhomes sold in Vancouver Heights with a median price of $835,000, taking a median of 25 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $794 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median strata fee of $470 a month.

faq.a: No — it is a City of Burnaby neighbourhood in North Burnaby, east of Boundary Road, on and below the Capitol Hill rise. SD41 School Locator checks for two in-area Pandora Street addresses (4375 and 4715 Pandora St) both returned Alpha Secondary, with Rosser Elementary for the first and Confederation Park Elementary for the second. Burnaby North Secondary (751 Hammarskjold Dr) is located in North Burnaby, but location is not catchment. Run the exact address before writing an offer.
faq.q: Which secondary school serves the Heights — Burnaby North?

faq.a: No, it's in Burnaby. Despite the name, Vancouver Heights is a City of Burnaby neighbourhood in North Burnaby, east of Boundary Road. Its sales are reported under Burnaby, and Burnaby's taxes, bylaws and school district (SD41) apply, so there's no Vancouver Empty Homes Tax.

Alpha Secondary: the School Locator puts both 4375 and 4715 Pandora Street in Alpha's catchment. Burnaby North Secondary is also in North Burnaby, but it isn't the catchment secondary for those Pandora addresses.
